newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Orient-Avia cargo traffic growth grows in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Orient-Avia cargo traffic growth grows in 1996.

text.p: Private Russian airline Orient-Avia carried 107,000 passengers and 746 tonnes of cargo during the first eight months of this year, an increase on last year's total for the same period, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
She said in the whole of 1995, Orient-Avia carried 100,000 passengers and 450 tonnes of cargo.
The Moscow-based carrier, established in 1994, operates four Ilyushin-62M jets on routes between Moscow and Vladivostok and Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky in the Russian Far East.
The company recently bought two Tupolev-134 short range planes for use on shorter routes, she said.
